input.quote: 5.8.1 Harpoon shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to (a) directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory, or (b) license, authorize, appoint, or otherwise enable any Third Party to directly or indirectly, develop, commercialize or otherwise exploit any Competing Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory, except, in each case ((a) and (b)), as otherwise expressly provided in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The only exclusivity/non-compete covenant in the Agreement (Section 5.8, "Exclusivity with Respect to the Territory") binds Harpoon and its Affiliates, not AbbVie, and Section 7.1.2 confirms that exclusivity obligations exist only "in the case of Harpoon." Section 5.8.2 further preserves Harpoon's acquisition/change-of-control flexibility and gives AbbVie protective rights. Searches for restrictions on AbbVie (e.g., "AbbVie shall not" develop/commercialize, field-of-use or territory limits, post-termination covenants) and review of Articles 3, 4, 5 and AbbVie's covenants in Section 10.4 found no non-compete, competing-product or field-of-use restriction on AbbVie or its Affiliates; the licenses' Field/Territory scoping is grant scope, not a restrictive covenant. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete on the customer), and the Harpoon-side restriction benefits us, so no redline is proposed.
